帧间（FrameBetween）是一款完全在设备本地运行的音视频处理工作台：以: FrameBetween is an on-device audio/video workstation powered by FFmpeg / FFprobe, bringing desktop-grade command-line editing to your phone. There is no account and no cloud service - your media never leaves the device.
· 一站式本地处理：压缩与格式转换、时长与画面裁剪、删除帧（音画同步）、视频合并: - All-in-one local editing: compression and format conversion, trim by time or by frame, frame deletion (audio kept in sync), merging, flips and mirroring, speed change, mute and audio extraction, audio join / cut, and GIF export - all on the device
· 字幕与水印：字幕提取 / 嵌入 / 烧录；文字与图片水印可在预览里拖动定位、: - Subtitles and watermarks: extract, mux or burn in subtitles; drag and pinch text / image watermarks on the preview, set font color, opacity and time range, or use random and bouncing motion; remove watermarks with a visual selection box, blur, mosaic or delogo
· 命令行的透明度：直接执行 FFmpeg 参数，提供快捷模板与光标处插入路径，: - Command-line transparency: run raw FFmpeg arguments, use quick templates and insert paths at the cursor, follow live logs, progress and a three-line failure digest. Every job shows the exact command that was executed
· 媒体库与文件管理：只收录音视频的文件夹 / 树形 / 文件三视图，可选嵌套文: - Library and file management: folder / tree / file views that list audio and video only, optional nested folders with step-by-step expansion, a drag-to-scroll thumb, new-media badges and incremental refresh; All Files next to the title browses the phone directory directly
· 画质与性能：默认 H.265 编码、沿用源素材平均码率避免「越编越大」、可选: - Quality and performance: H.265 by default, source average bitrate reused to avoid oversized output, optional MediaCodec hardware decoding, outputs named after the source file plus a timestamp, 64-bit builds only
· AI 助手（可选）：可对接云端或本地 OpenAI 兼容模型，结合 ffpr: - Optional AI assistant: connect any OpenAI-compatible cloud or local model. 帧间（FrameBetween）是一款完全在设备本地运行的音视频处理工具，包名: FrameBetween (package com.framebetween.app) is an audio/video tool that runs entirely on your device. There are no accounts, no cloud services and no servers of our own; transcoding, trimming, merging, frame deletion, speed change, subtitles, watermarks and GIF export are all performed by the on-device FFmpeg engine.
我们不收集姓名、邮箱、手机号、设备标识符、广告 ID、位置、通讯录、剪贴板或应用: We do not collect names, email addresses, phone numbers, device identifiers, advertising IDs, location, contacts, clipboard contents or usage behaviour. Output is written by default to the app's external private directory (Android/data/<package>/files/Movies/FrameBetween), and can also be saved to the system media library or a folder you choose. File names consist of the original file name plus an MMddHHmmss timestamp and contain no personal information.
媒体读取权限（Android 13 及以上的 READ_MEDIA_VIDEO: Media read permissions (READ_MEDIA_VIDEO / AUDIO / IMAGES on Android 13+, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE on older versions) let All Files browse phone directories, import what you pick and build thumbnails / audio covers. The three library views list audio and video only - images are not mixed into the media list.
INTERNET：仅用于「求助 AI」「AI 解析」「AI效果评估」「查询可用模: INTERNET is used only for Ask AI, AI Diagnosis, AI Evaluation, List models, Test connection and GitHub / dependency links you open. POST_NOTIFICATIONS shows foreground task progress; FOREGROUND_SERVICE / DATA_SYNC keep long jobs alive.
1. 应用不会在后台自动联网。使用 AI 功能时，只向你填写的 OpenAI 兼: 1. The app never connects in the background. AI features send only the following to the OpenAI-compatible endpoint you configured: your question text, ffprobe media parameters (duration, codec, bitrate, resolution, etc.), before / after parameter summaries, your editing goal and a redacted command (real paths replaced with input path / output path). AI Diagnosis also attaches the failure reason, error log and FFmpeg version; AI Evaluation additionally sends an ffprobe summary of the output file to judge whether your goal was met. With prompts disabled, only your raw text is sent; multi-turn chat forwards the current conversation context to the same endpoint. Media file contents and device information are never sent.
2. 提供商、API 地址、模型名称与 API 密钥只保存在本机 SharedP: 2. Provider, API address, model name and API key are stored only in on-device SharedPreferences. No key is bundled and no request is proxied or relayed. When multi-turn chat is enabled, the conversation is also kept only on this device and is removed when you clear the chat or the app cache. Local models (Ollama, LM Studio, etc.) may use an empty key, and the UI shows only the first and last four characters of a key.
设置项、语言与主题、媒体库排序 / 视图偏好、嵌套文件夹开关、文件夹黑白名单与扫: Settings, language and theme, library sort / view preferences, the nested-folders switch, folder allow / deny lists and scan paths are kept in the app's private storage. Thumbnail and metadata caches live in the app cache and can be cleared under Folder settings > Library maintenance; input copies and temporary outputs are reclaimed when a job ends, you switch files or the app cold-starts. Outputs remain until you delete the task, clear completed jobs, clear the app cache or uninstall. Uninstalling removes all data in the app's private directory; files already exported to the system media library or a custom folder are yours to manage.
